description: Pick a base folder and hop between its subfolders from the sidebar, opening each one as your workspace
view.name: Folders
welcome:
Welcome to FolderHop! Pick the base folder that holds the folders you want to hop between (your courses, projects, clients...).
[Choose base folder](command:folderhop.chooseRoot)
config.root: Base folder whose subfolders are listed in the sidebar. Supports ~ for your home folder.
